scientific_integrity: The universal Lefschetz formula has a self-contained signed fixed-simplex proof; underlying homology ranks are cited from a published 2026 theorem. Finite exact checks are confirmatory and do not substitute for the universal proof. Unindexed overlap remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Only the central half-turn action and its rational representation; no odd-case integral module classification, full dihedral representation, or equivariant homotopy type.
title: The antipodal half-turn representation on Möbius-ladder perfect-matching homology
